reroute_reason: The original bundle was clearly mis-routed: the question is about Oslo's VPO NOK system, but both retrievals were T2S-only (matching_concept and matching_fields, which return the same t2s-matching section), so the entity actually asked about had no retrieval at all. Kept matching_concept (a superset of matching_fields: it returns t2s-matching plus t2s-posting) and added the Oslo routes listed in topic-index.json: oslo_instruction_submission_settlement, oslo_finality_moments, oslo_preliminary_calculation_priority, liquidity_duties and approval_status (all Oslo, settlement, mode reference), plus the listed blocked topic oslo_operational_calendar to surface the VPO NOK documentation gap. All contexts use question types, entities, services, modes and review dates present in topic-index.json; no invented values.
notes: Final bundle statuses: 6 x evidence_only, 1 x blocked (oslo_operational_calendar, GAP ID G11). Checker: 10/10 passed on the first run; no fix iteration was needed. The reroute produced the decisive evidence the original bundle lacked: the LIMITATION on oslo-finality-moments states that VPO NOK is a Norwegian netting system outside T2S and that T2S lifecycle rules do not apply, and oslo-submission-settlement shows the cash leg recorded in Norwegian kroner on VPO LOM accounts at Norges Bank. Combined with the t2s-matching condition that the tolerance is configured per currency and that the EUR bands must not be generalised to other currencies, the answer is a clear no. The answer also refuses the tempting over-reach: it states that whether VPO NOK applies any tolerance of its own is unresolved (the Rules name no figure and the User Documentation is not admitted, gap G11), that no NOK T2S band is in evidence, and that the bundle says nothing about whether Euronext Securities Oslo operates any other settlement service. Oslo qualifications carried throughout: English translation of a Norwegian original which prevails, cover reservation 'subject to approval by Finanstilsynet' with edition approval unresolved (gap G07), reference-description basis, review dates 13 and 14 September 2026.
